high_level_description: A close-up product photograph of a matte black ceramic coffee mug on a warm wooden table, three roasted coffee beans beside it, soft window light from the left.

style_description.aesthetics: warm, tactile, premium, calm and editorial
style_description.lighting: soft directional window light from the upper left, gentle wraparound fill, subtle specular highlight on the ceramic rim
style_description.photo: 85mm portrait lens, f/4, slight top-down 30-degree angle, shallow depth of field isolating the mug

compositional_deconstruction.background: A warm walnut wooden table surface with visible grain running left to right, slightly out of focus. Soft falloff to a creamy off-white in the upper portion suggesting a window-lit wall.

elements.desc: A matte black ceramic coffee mug, cylindrical with a subtle taper toward the base and a simple rounded handle on the right. A faint steam curl rises from the open top. The surface has a soft satin sheen, not glossy.
Three roasted coffee beans scattered in a loose triangle to the left of the mug, mid-tone brown with the characteristic center crease catching a tiny highlight.
A soft circular shadow cast by the mug onto the wooden table, fading gently outward and grounding the object.
